listing.description: Tucked into the Montclair hills, 6944 Snake Rd brings together mid-century modern character, a welcome sense of privacy, and sweeping Bay and SF views. With expansive outlooks on one side and a private, newly landscaped yard on the other, the home offers the best of both worlds: a place to take in spectacular sunsets and city lights, and a sheltered garden retreat for sunny afternoons, outdoor dining, and warm-weather gatherings. Multiple decks and inviting outdoor spaces extend the home's living footprint, creating an effortless connection between indoors and out, with a place to enjoy the setting at virtually any time of day. The main level is designed for connection and entertaining, with a light-filled living room, dining area, and kitchen that flow naturally together. The kitchen opens to the dining area, which connects directly to a deck and yard, making it easy to move between cooking, dining, and relaxing outdoors. Whether hosting friends for dinner, enjoying a morning coffee in the garden, or unwinding on the view deck at sunset, the home's outdoor spaces feel like natural extensions of the interior. The main-level primary suite enjoys its own walk-in closet, full bath, and access to the view deck, bringing the scenery into a more private setting. A second bedroom and full hall bath complete the main level, offering flexibility for guests, family, or a home office. Downstairs, a spacious family room or den with fireplace offers a wonderful counterpoint to the open, social spaces above. Tucked away from the main living areas, it's an ideal retreat for movie nights, quiet evenings, a playroom, or a more intimate place to gather. Two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a dedicated laundry room with washer and dryer complete this level. A small deck with stairs connects to the backyard, while generous closets, built-in cabinetry, and a large two-car garage provide welcome storage and utility. With its mid-century modern architecture, flexible two-level layout, and seamless connection to the outdoors, this Montclair home offers a distinctive balance of openness and privacy. Montclair Village, freeway access, tennis courts, and an elementary school are all nearby, keeping neighborhood conveniences within easy reach. From sunset views over the Bay to leisurely afternoons in the garden, 6944 Snake Rd is a home that invites you to spread out, settle in, and enjoy every side of its beautiful setting.

lot_usability.note: 0.20 ac downslope (MLS topography): usable share = flat lawn + decks (p_08, p_10); remainder is terraced slope with CMU retaining walls (p_09, p_12). Better than most hills lots, not a flat lot.

verdict: 6944 Snake is a light-flooded 1963 gabled contemporary whose west wall opens to verified panoramic Bay/SF/city-lights views, paired with a rare flat lawn and terraced private garden — the trade-off is buying that view-and-light package at a Very High FHSZ address with the insurance friction that implies, on a shared driveway off Hemlock Lane, with a lower level (family room, 2 bedrooms, bath, laundry) the listing never photographs. At $421/sf — roughly half the $828/sf 6833 Snake just closed at ~410 ft away — the price reads as the local list-low/bid-up playbook rather than a hidden defect, but the unphotographed lower level and the insurance quote are the two facts to nail down before chasing it over ask.
